usage: SplitExtendBed.py [-h] [--output_fn OUTPUT_FN] [--bed_fn BED_FN]
                         [--expand_region_size EXPAND_REGION_SIZE]
                         [--ctgName CTGNAME] [--ctgStart CTGSTART]
                         [--ctgEnd CTGEND]

Extend bed region for pileup calling

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output_fn OUTPUT_FN
                        Path to directory that stores small bins, default:
                        None)
  --bed_fn BED_FN       Path of the output folder, default: None
  --expand_region_size EXPAND_REGION_SIZE
                        Expand region size for each bed region, default: 33
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed, default: None
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed
